_doku: ADS hand table (T322, W2 diagnosis 2026-09-26). Read by lib/ads-hand-table.js at both marketCap write sites of pull-yahoo.js.
Row = a US ADS line whose Yahoo marketCap is (ADS price x ORDINARY share count), i.e. ordinaryPerAds times too large.
Correction divides by ordinaryPerAds ONLY while the error is still visible: marketCap within 3 % of price x Yahoo share count
AND Yahoo's share count still on the ordinary scale (nearer yahooOrdinaryShares than yahooOrdinaryShares / ordinaryPerAds).
Otherwise Yahoo's value stays and the pull logs a WARN 'stale row' - re-verify, then fix or remove the row. Never double-correct.
Admission: SEC filing quote for the ratio + a foreign pair leg whose marketCap confirms the corrected value. LU is NOT a row (Yahoo is correct there).

HSAI.source: SEC 6-K July 2026, acc. 0001104659-26-082432: "Following the ADS Ratio Change, each ADS now represents eight (8) Class B ordinary shares."

BSBR.source: SEC 20-F 2026-02-27, ex. 2.5: "Each ADS represents one (1) unit"; units "each representing one common share and one preferred share"
